intent.summary:
Implements WELL-16's bounded Phase-8 graduated recovery through the existing Identity, Communications, Content and Audit owners. Verified-email recovery uses an expiring single-use proof, explicit confirmation and guarded password replacement. Stronger proof-backed recovery retains current scoped step-up, independent second-person approval, E1 and independent Account hold release.

The implementation is continued from PR #217 without rewriting its 23 implementation commits. Unsupported zero-factor completion remains denied under the approved bounded Phase-8 acceptance. No production, public release, real-participant delivery or Phase-9 permission is included.
intent.title: WELL-16: complete bounded graduated recovery and delivery
